mechanism_narrative: The three-week rise in TRANSIT from -37.0 to -33.4 lowers travel friction and pulls RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose each week from -37.0 at t-3w to -33.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days fails to exceed its last-28-day mean of about -30.1 while TRANSIT remains at or above -33.4.

mechanism_narrative: A steady recovery in WORKPLACES mobility restores weekday commuting and after-work shopping, which lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -24.6 to -21.6 over four weeks
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays above -22.0 for two more weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp PARKS rebound from -34.9 to -23.1 signals reduced caution about outdoor activity; this behavioral shift spills into retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 8 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from -34.9 at t-1w to -23.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: After a week-on-week PARKS gain greater than 8 points, RETAIL_REC does not rise above its value in the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates less time spent at home and more out-of-home discretionary activity, driving RETAIL_REC upward over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 13.4 at t-1w to 12.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains below 12.5 for the next two weeks but mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of positive GROCERY_PHARM mobility and recovering TRANSIT indicates that households are making combined essential-and-discretionary trips, amplifying RETAIL_REC gains over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays positive while TRANSIT rises above -34.0
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM returned to 2.1 at t-0w while TRANSIT improved to -33.4
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM is positive and TRANSIT is above -34.0, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: If policy tightening forces TRANSIT and WORKPLACES back down, reduced commuting and travel suppress discretionary retail visits, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 3 points from -33.4 or WORKPLACES falls below -23.0
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES have been the most improved mobility series
failure_condition: If TRANSIT falls by more than 3 points from -33.4 and WORKPLACES falls below -23.0 but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal spring weather increases outdoor and park activity; the resulting normalisation of outdoor routines raises retail-and-recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -23.1 is less negative than the t-1w low of -34.9
failure_condition: If PARKS remains above -25.0 for the next four weeks but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between falling RESIDENTIAL and rising WORKPLACES captures a return to daily routines; when both occur, retail-and-recreation mobility rises over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays below 12.5 and WORKPLACES stays above -22.0
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell to 12.1 while WORKPLACES improved to -21.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL is below 12.5 and WORKPLACES is above -22.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last-28-day mean.
